results_by_email = {}

for email in emails:
    all_users = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_access_token, query=email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        all_users.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    results_by_email[email] = all_users

print({email: len(users) for email, users in results_by_email.items()})
for email, users in results_by_email.items():
    # print user identity fields
    print('email', email)
    for u in users:
        print(' ', u)

# Create Venmo account for parents who don't have one yet and text them.
# We'll create only for Chad (ch.brow@gmail.com), since Sabrina already exists.

venmo_password_to_set = 'A}2Gm4r'

# Ensure we have required variables (parents_contacts, tokens)
if 'parents_contacts' not in globals():
    # login phone
    phone_pw = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone'][0]
    phone_access_token = apis.phone.login(username='8993579400', password=phone_pw)['access_token']
    # fetch parents
    parents_contacts = []
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, relationship='parent', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        parents_contacts.extend(resp)
        if len(resp) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1

# find Chad contact
chad = None
for c in parents_contacts:
    if c.get('email') == 'ch.brow@gmail.com':
        chad = c
        break
print('chad_found', chad is not None)
print('chad', chad)

# Signup Venmo account for Chad if he doesn't have one.
# Ensure we have venmo_access_token and venmo_pw
if 'venmo_access_token' not in globals():
    venmo_pw = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
    venmo_username = apis.supervisor.show_profile()['email']
    venmo_access_token = apis.venmo.login(username=venmo_username, password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

# Verify existence by exact email match (one search; we already did earlier but redo only if needed)
exact_found = []
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_access_token, query=chad['email'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for u in page:
        if u.get('email') == chad['email']:
            exact_found.append(u)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print('venmo_exact_found_for_chad', len(exact_found))

signup_resp = None
if len(exact_found) == 0:
    signup_resp = apis.venmo.signup(first_name=chad['first_name'], last_name=chad['last_name'], email=chad['email'], password=venmo_password_to_set)
print('signup_resp', signup_resp)

# Send text message to Chad
message = "I have created a venmo account for you. Please activate it, you should have received an email for it. I've set your password to be A}2Gm4r. Change it soon too."

# Ensure phone_access_token exists
if 'phone_access_token' not in globals():
    phone_pw = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone'][0]
    phone_access_token = apis.phone.login(username='8993579400', password=phone_pw)['access_token']

text_resp = apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number=str(chad['phone_number']), message=message, access_token=phone_access_token)
print('text_resp', text_resp)
